strings: After all this time, some of the Clan thinks that m_c should have started speaking again. r_c0 simply shakes their head, it's not up to those cats to demand that.
m_c simply shakes {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head when a Clanmate asks if {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} going to start speaking again soon.
The Clan doesn't think twice about m_c's silence, that's just how {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is}.
m_c softly pads out into the clearing, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/don't/doesn't} need to use words to talk. {PRONOUN/m_c/poss/CAP} cat-sign is loud enough.
